request.story_prompt:
Maya is a young girl who enters a mysterious forest alone. Deep inside the forest, she discovers an old Game Machine near a huge tree.
Curious, Maya touches the machine.
Suddenly—
“GAME START!” 🎮
The forest gates close, and Maya becomes trapped inside the game.
🔴 Level 1 – Forest Run
Maya must run through the dark forest while a terrifying shadow chases her. She avoids dangerous obstacles and successfully completes Level 1.
🟠 Level 2 – Mystery House
Maya enters an abandoned house filled with mysterious puzzles. She must solve the puzzles and find the correct exit before the game resets.
Using her intelligence, Maya completes Level 2.
🟢 Level 3 – Final Choice
Maya reaches the final room. On a table, she finds two cards:
1️⃣ LOSE
2️⃣ WIN
A mysterious voice says:
“Choose only one card…”
Maya takes a deep breath and chooses the WIN card.
Suddenly—
💥 GAME COMPLETED! 💥
The door opens, and Maya escapes from the forest.
Outside, she discovers the game's grand prize: bags of money, gold, and treasure. 💰💎

panels.title: The Discovery
panels.scene_description: Alex, a young girl with messy hair and a backpack, stands before a massive, glowing tree in the heart of the enchanted forest. She reaches out to touch an ancient, glowing arcade machine embedded in the tree trunk.

panels.title: Game Start
panels.scene_description: A holographic screen flickers to life with 'GAME START!' in bold pixels. The forest behind Alex turns into digital lines, and heavy iron gates slam shut, trapping her in a pixelated reality.
panels.image_prompt: Comic book style, Alex looking surprised, holographic text GAME START glowing in the air, the forest surroundings turning into digital glitchy pixels, iron gates slamming shut in the background, action-oriented composition.

panels.title: Level 1: The Chase
panels.scene_description: Alex is sprinting through a dark, ominous version of the forest. Behind her, a towering, ink-black shadow monster with glowing eyes lunges forward, forcing her to jump over a jagged rock obstacle.
panels.image_prompt: Comic book style, motion lines, Alex running fast away from a giant terrifying shadow creature, dark forest setting with glowing mushrooms, dynamic perspective, intense shadows and highlights.

panels.title: Level 2: The Puzzle
panels.scene_description: Inside a dusty, abandoned Victorian-style room, Alex focuses intently as she aligns glowing runes on a stone pedestal, unlocking a hidden mechanism while a timer counts down above her head.
panels.image_prompt: Comic book style, indoor setting, Alex solving a glowing puzzle on a stone table, dust motes in the air, magical aura, a digital timer floating in the top corner, sharp focus on Alex's determined expression.

panels.title: Victory and Reward
panels.scene_description: Alex stands outside the forest edge, the game machine vanished. She holds the 'WIN' card in one hand, while piles of gold coins and sparkling gems spill out from a chest at her feet.
panels.image_prompt: Comic book style, bright sunlight, Alex smiling triumphantly, holding a golden card, massive treasure chest filled with gold and jewels in the foreground, lush forest edge background, triumphant atmosphere.
